scientificLaws.text: A body immersed wholly or partly in a fluid experiences an upthrust equal to the weight of fluid displaced by it.
For an inviscid, incompressible fluid in streamline flow, an increase in fluid speed occurs simultaneously with a decrease in pressure. Explains aerodynamic lift on aeroplane wings.
At constant temperature, the volume of a given mass of gas is inversely proportional to its pressure: P × V = Constant.
At constant pressure, volume of a given mass of gas is directly proportional to its absolute temperature: V / T = Constant.
Equal volumes of all gases under identical conditions of temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules (6.022 × 10²³ per mole).
Every object continues in its state of rest or uniform motion in a straight line unless acted upon by an external net unbalanced force.
The rate of change of momentum of a body is directly proportional to the applied force and acts in the direction of the force: F = m × a.
To every action, there is always an equal and opposite reaction.
Every particle in the universe attracts every other particle with a force proportional to product of masses and inversely proportional to square of distance: F = G(m₁m₂)/r².
Current passing through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to potential difference across them at constant temperature: V = I × R.

1. Planets move in elliptical orbits with the Sun at one focus. 2. Radius vector sweeps out equal areas in equal intervals of time. 3. Square of orbital period (T²) is proportional to cube of semi-major axis (R³).
Energy can neither be created nor destroyed; it can only be transformed from one form to another. Total energy of the universe remains constant.
